review_basis: Direct inspection of the saved original and unresampled specimen and microscope/slides crops. Qualitative coordinator review; not a blind comparison or requesting-user judgment.
visible: Reference-guided short dark bob, separated fringe and similar facial proportions
A capped clear glass vial with a pale folded object inside amber liquid and a distinguishable meniscus
One clear central vial among several heavily frosted neighboring vials
Distinct droplets on the glass and a wet-looking bounded area around the vial base on steel
Connected gloved hands and arms, with one hand bracing the rack and the other hovering above the cap
Gaze directed toward the specimen, open frosted freezer and restrained clinical unease
Recognizable microscope, a separate rack of glass slides with paper end labels, and the distinct central specimen vial
failed_or_unobservable: Actor-relative hands are reversed: her right hand on screen-left braces the rack, while her left hand on screen-right hovers. The frozen authored choreography specified left brace/right hover.
The microscope foot/base and its bench-support endpoint are occluded or cropped. The complete retained A08 source relation cannot pass from visible equipment fragments alone.
claim_limits: Appearance continuity does not authenticate identity or medical history.
Frost contrast and a generated temperature display do not prove actual temperature or thaw history.
The depicted specimen and slide patches do not prove human origin, diagnosis, culture viability, infection or histopathology.
The visible moisture satisfies the bounded-moisture case without proving chemical identity, leak mechanism, or an inside-versus-outside condensation surface.
Clinical suspense is readable; intense horror impact and user acceptance remain unconfirmed.
